AGENTS

For an AI agent (and any person) working in this repository: what to read, what to run, and what never to do.

Read

  1. station.json: what this is, its version and status.
  2. .station/STATUS.md: what passes, what is open, which jobs exist.
  3. docs/README.md: where each topic lives.
  4. docs/architecture.md before touching engine/ or platforms/.
  5. docs/design/appearance.md before touching UI or tokens.
  6. The open job's SESSION.md in .station/jobs/, or open a new job for new work.

Run

CommandWhen
make setupOnce per machine: checks the toolchain
make validateBefore every commit; must be green
make testAfter any change to engine/ or Swift code
make tokensAfter editing design/tokens/obsidian.tokens.json
make siteAfter editing docs, AGENTS.md, ROADMAP, CHANGELOG, tokens or the version
make distAt a release: writes dist/soundboard-<version>.zip and its checksum

Work goes on a branch, then a pull request, then a merge to main. Commits end with the attribution lines the session gives.

Never

  • Never allocate, lock, log or wait on the audio thread (render, process, anything called from an audio callback). Commands go through the lock-free queue; memory is released by generation.
  • Never let anything reach the master bus because of a cue, preview or headphone action. The routing prototype's bit-identical check is the proof; keep it passing.
  • Never edit a generated file. Each carries a "Generated … do not edit" header; change its source and re-run its generator. make validate fails on drift.
  • Never write a raw colour, size or font in UI or site code. Use semantic tokens.
  • Never delete something questionable. Move it to .archives/removal-safe/<name>/ with a README.
  • Never commit secrets, signing identities, provisioning profiles or local.properties.
  • Never rely on the hardware volume buttons for mixing, or route cue audio to Bluetooth.
  • Never push to main directly, rewrite published history, or move a release tag.

Source: AGENTS.md
